zh.title: 國防部偵獲共機14架次與共艦9艘 6架次逾越海峽中線
zh.summary: 國防部表示，自8月5日上午6時至8月6日上午6時止，共偵獲14架次共機、9艘共艦及7艘公務船在台海周邊活動。其中有6架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線，侵擾中部、西南及東部空域。國軍運用任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控並妥善應處。
body: 台灣國防部於2026年8月6日上午發布最新國軍監控軍事動態統計指出，統計自8月5日上午6時起至8月6日上午6時止，在台灣海峽及周邊區域共計偵獲中共軍機14架次、共艦9艘，以及7艘公務船持續進行活動。
國防部進一步說明，在上述偵獲的中共軍機中，計有6架次逾越台灣海峽中線，進入台灣中部、西南及東部空域持續活動。針對中共軍機與艦艇動態，國軍已運用任務機、任務艦及岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與應處。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 14 PLA Aircraft and 9 Naval Vessels Around Island
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported detecting 14 Chinese military aircraft, nine naval vessels, and seven official ships operating around the island between 06:00 on August 5 and 06:00 on August 6, 2026. According to official figures, six of the aircraft sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering Taiwan's central, southwestern, and eastern airspace. In response, Taiwan's armed forces deployed combat air patrols, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the military activity around the Taiwan Strait.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released its daily military tracking report on the morning of August 6, 2026. The ministry stated that between 06:00 on August 5 and 06:00 on August 6, a total of 14 Chinese military aircraft, nine PLAN naval vessels, and seven official ships were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait and surrounding maritime areas.

According to the defense authorities, six of the detected aircraft sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering Taiwan's central, southwestern, and eastern airspace. In response to the presence of Chinese aircraft and vessels, the Republic of China Armed Forces deployed air patrol aircraft, naval ships, and land-based missile systems to maintain close surveillance and respond accordingly.
